graders.name: answers
graders.criteria: The final message gives a recommendation on each question: one skill per vendor or one skill over several vendors, using scripts instead of skill text, and Node or Python for the CLI.

graders.name: cli-language
graders.criteria: The reply recommends Node or Python for the CLI with a reason tied to this repository, which is a Node 22 TypeScript project run with tsx and tested with vitest.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.description: A plan discussion changes no files.

graders.name: no-writes
graders.description: The transcript shows no file writes, even ones later undone.

graders.name: script-keeps-judgment
graders.criteria: The reply moves the mechanical fetch, parse, deduplicate and format work into a script or CLI the skill calls, and leaves judgment in the skill text, such as which sources to use and what to report when a source fails or sources disagree.

graders.name: shared-in-one-place
graders.criteria: If the plan keeps more than one data skill, what they share (the CLI, source configuration, the output format) lives in one place they all use, not copied into each skill. Pass if the plan has a single data skill.

graders.name: split-by-request
graders.criteria: The recommendation organizes data skills by what a user or brief asks for, such as news or quotes, with vendors as interchangeable sources inside one skill or the script it calls, and keeps a separate skill only where a distinct kind of request should reach it on its own. Fail if it recommends one skill per vendor for the same kind of data.
